text:
alyssa: Hey team — quick sync on onboarding the new 30B MQA (gqa+sliding-window) model. Two quick blockers: where are the canonical weights, and we're seeing a tokenizer mismatch in local smoke. Any pointers? :eyes:

matt: weights are in s3: s3://redwood-models/private/30b-mqa/v1/weights.tar.lz4. ping me if you need access keys (it's on the infra bucket). :handshake:

jia: saw the tokenization issue — tokenizer merges differ from the hf repo. If you load the shipped tokenizer it prepends a special BOS which our pipeline double-counts. Quick fix is to use the `merge_normalization: false` flag when building vocab or run `python -m tokenizers.convert` with the provided merges.

samir: also, check the tokenizer config at `configs/tokenizer.yaml` — we had a legacy `add_bos: true` in our runtime default. That'll double-insert if the tokenizer already emits BOS.

alyssa: ok good call. matt can you confirm that the release tar includes the `tokenizer.json` and `merges.txt`?
matt: yep — `tokenizer.json`, `merges.txt`, and `special_tokens_map.json` are in the tar. I just unpacked locally.

ci-bot: unit tests: tokenization-smoke FAILED (examples/tokenizer/smoke_test.py::test_length_consistency) — length mismatch 512 vs 513. Full log: `tests/tokenizer/smoke_test.log`

jia: that matches the double-BOS hypothesis. I'm going to open a tiny PR to gate the runtime default and add a migration step to detect tokenizer-emitted BOS.

alyssa: assign CR to @jia. Can someone run a quick config lint on the attention/rope settings? We had a few models that required rotary scaling tweaks for the GQA/MQA variants.
samir: giving a quick grep of model config shows `rope_scaling: 1.0` and `rope_mode: dynamic` in `configs/30b-mqa.yaml`. For GQA models we usually set `rope_alpha: 16` and `rotary_scale: 0.75` (depending on attn impl). Might need a per-variant override: `rope_overrides: { \"gqa_heads\": 16 }`.
jia: here's a minimal config snippet I'm going to include in the PR to keep defaults explicit:

```yaml
model:
  name: 30b-mqa
  attn_impl: flash
  rope:
    mode: dynamic
    scaling: 1.0
    overrides:
      gqa:
        scaling: 0.75
        heads: 16
```

matt: heads-up: our current flash-attn kernels assume KV cache layout A; GQA->MQA head remap might need the `remap_kv: true` flag. If you flip that on, run the perf smoke (see `scripts/perf_smoke.sh`).

alyssa: noted. matt can you run perf smoke on a dev GPU and report tail latency? If perf regressions are severe we fallback to 13B quantized for the canary.
matt: will run in ~30m. quick command I use: `./scripts/run_smoke --model s3://redwood-models/private/30b-mqa/v1/ --seq 1024 --batch 4 --check-latency`.

ci-bot: perf results posted: latency p95=160ms, p99=310ms on p4d dev box. No correctness regressions after applying `remap_kv: true` and tokenizer fix.

alyssa: great. jia — can you add the tokenizer detection + config override and link the PR here? Also add a small e2e prompt that exercises sliding-window contexts so we don't regress there.
jia: on it. PR in draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 (adds tokenizer autopatch + rope overrides + test).

samir: quick QA note — if you enable `rope.mode: dynamic` we should add a rollout check that compares attention outputs at 1.0 vs 0.75 scaling on a fixed prompt set. I can add that to the rollout gating script.

alyssa: perfect. Plan: jia merges after 1 LGTM, matt runs canary tomorrow 14:00 PT in us-west, samir will add the rollout comparator, and ci-bot will ensure smoke tests pass. If anything flakey, fallback path -> 13b-quant on same route.
matt: :thumbsup: I'll post canary results in this thread after run.
jia: will request review from @samir and @alyssa.

alyssa: thanks all. Heads-up to ops: add the model path to the allowlist for dedicated pools (`infra-allowlist`) before canary.

matt: noted and done. infra ticket #INF-1123 updated.

alyssa: closing the loop — if ci-bot shows green post-PR I'll schedule the canary. Thanks :pray:
